Meta.title: See your beach on Sunbnb
Meta.description: Enter your beach and number of sunbeds and see them on the map, ready for guests to book online.

Hero.title: Let guests book your sunbeds before they reach the sand
Hero.subtitle: Guests pick their exact sunbed on a map and pay by card. Find your beach and see it working there, in under a minute.

noshow.title: Front-row sunbeds, paid before guests arrive
noshow.subtitle: Guests choose their exact sunbed on a map and pay online. See it on your own beach — free, in under a minute.

cash.title: Stop handling cash on the sand
cash.subtitle: Guests pay by card when they book their sunbed or order drinks to it. See how it looks on your own beach.

online.title: Let tourists book your sunbeds online
online.subtitle: Put your exact sunbeds on a map guests can book from their phone. See it on your own beach now.

queue.title: No more queues at the sunbed kiosk
queue.subtitle: Guests arrive with a QR pass and walk straight to their sunbed. See it on your own beach.

order.title: Drinks ordered from the sunbed, paid in the app
order.subtitle: Guests order from their phone. Your bar sees every order live, with a sound alert.

rent.title: Rent out paddleboards and kayaks by the hour
rent.subtitle: Guests book and pay for equipment online. Staff mark it picked up and returned.

checkin.title: Your staff see every booking, live
checkin.subtitle: Find any guest by name and check them in with one tap. Cash sales and the day close too.

invoice.title: Every sale invoiced, VAT included
invoice.subtitle: Receipts and invoices go out automatically, with your own numbering and VAT rate.

order.title: Drinks ordered from the sunbed
order.body: Guests order from their phone and pay in the app. Your bar sees every order live, with a sound alert, and moves it from new to delivered.

rent.title: Rentals by the hour or the day
rent.body: Paddleboards, kayaks, pedal boats and more: guests book and pay online, and your staff mark them picked up and returned.

checkin.title: Your whole beach, live
checkin.body: Every booking on one grid. Find a guest by name and check them in with a tap; add walk-ins and cash sales; close the day per employee.

invoice.title: Invoices and VAT, done
invoice.body: Every sale gets its receipt or invoice in your name, with your own numbering and VAT rate, and an export for your accountant.
invoice.spain: In Spain, Veri*factu is coming before the 2027 deadline.

Start.title: How it starts
Start.s1: Lay out your rows on the map of your beach and print a QR card for each sunbed.
Start.s2: Your price per day, per row or per sunbed. Payments go to your own Mollie account.
Start.s3: Guests find your beach, pick their sunbed and pay. You see every booking live.

Faq.title: Questions beach owners ask
Faq.noPhoneQ: What about guests without a smartphone?
Faq.noPhoneA: Your staff add walk-in bookings and cash sales at the desk, on the same grid as the online bookings.
Faq.hardwareQ: Do I need to buy any hardware?
Faq.hardwareA: No. Sunbnb runs in the browser on the phones, tablets and laptops you already have, and guests don’t need to download an app.
Faq.paidA: Through your own Mollie account. Mollie pays you out on its schedule with Sunbnb’s commission deducted; Sunbnb never holds your money.
Faq.costA: Starter has no monthly fee: Sunbnb takes {pct}% only of what it sells for you. Pro and Business lower the commission to {pro}% and {business}% for a monthly fee.
Faq.languagesA: English, Spanish and Finnish, for you, your staff and your guests.
